title: Technical debt eats 30% of IT budgets
takeaways: 30% of IT budgets go to servicing technical debt (Protiviti)
Tech debt equals 20% to 40% of tech estate value (McKinsey)
Leaders plan about 15% of IT budget for remediation (Accenture)
46% of Indian firms say architecture blocks new apps (IDC)
98% have seen a modernisation initiative fail (IDC)
source_note: Sources: Protiviti; McKinsey 2020; Accenture 2024; IDC for MongoDB 2026
